payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for various datasets and models used in cyberbullying detection, including F1 scores and accuracy metrics.

claims.text: The F1 scores achieved were 0.94 for Wikipedia and 0.93 for Twitter datasets, and 0.95 with an accuracy of 98% for the Formspring dataset.
Traditional machine learning models performed significantly lower than DNN models in cyberbullying detection.
Oversampling bullying posts improved the performance of DNN models significantly across evaluation measures.
Transfer learning showed that the Formspring dataset had higher detection performance when using the Wikipedia model compared to the Twitter model.
